title: Jis Desh Mein Ganga Rehta Hai
desc: Ganga, an innocent man, is raised by a foster couple in a village. When he is brought back to his family in the city, he struggles to fit into modern society.

title: Surya The Soldier
desc: When a soldier lands in trouble due to his anger issues, he begins seeing a psychologist in hopes of one day returning to duty.

title: Aarzoo
desc: After her fiancé, Vijay is killed in a crash, a pregnant Pooja agrees to marry Amar, her childhood friend. However, her life takes yet another turn when Vijay returns to her life.

title: Shoorveer
desc: Siddharth, a fashion editor who hates horses, decides to venture into the world of horse racing to impress the girl of his dreams.

title: Jaan
desc: A top cop hires a man to guard his grandchild, unaware of the lurking threat. However, this protector is a hitman sent by kin to bump off the successor and grab the hefty estate.
